blocks.text: Lipids organic compounds ki aik qism hain jo jaanwaron aur paudon mein milte hain. In mein fats (charbi), phospholipids (jaise cell membrane mein), steroids aur terpenes (khushbudar teil, essential oils) shamil hain. Polysaccharides aur proteins ke ulat lipids polymers nahi hain, kyun ke in mein koi dohraya jane wala monomer unit nahi hota. Yeh hydrophobic (paani se door rehne wale) hain, lekin organic solvents mein ghul jate hain. Jaandaron mein lipids bohat se kaam karte hain: eendhan (fuel) molecules, signal molecules, membranes ke hisse, hormones aur cell ke andar paighaam pohanchane wale (messengers). Chemical banawat ke lihaz se lipids ko teen qismon mein baanta jata hai: simple lipids, complex (compound) lipids aur derived lipids.

blocks.prompt: Lipids ko polymers kyun nahi kaha jata?
blocks.explanation: In mein koi dohraya jane wala monomer unit nahi hota.

items: Lipids: fats, phospholipids, steroids, terpenes; hydrophobic, organic solvents mein ghulte; polymers nahi.
Qismein: simple, complex (compound) aur derived lipids.
